confidenceLimits: Fresh full review does not mean every historical expensive execution was repeated. Two baseline gates are fresh; 52 required gate outcomes retain their original date and pin.
New probes add bounded semantic/work evidence, not general GC, exhaustive branch or universal complexity proofs.

15 startup-only baseline instances are classified separately: 13 coordinators with 81 executed children, one disabled-loader negative control and one raw VM lane. Raw VM association is inferred from the serialized suite/harness, not an execution receipt.
Array catalogue delivery labels do not establish actual suspension for zero-argument methods; dedicated pending controls and precise assertions retain that responsibility.
